They were online transactions under product code(s) C, billed in region code 191.0, made from device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. How it was carried out: Device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 appears on 52 cards across 52 cardholders, marked new on 100% of its transactions and behind an anonymous proxy on 100%; 95 prior confirmed-fraud cases touch cards on this device. The same device profile was used by 19 other card(s) in the same period, including C10326-K1, C08168-K1, C01996-K2, C09975-K1, C02975-K1, C01289-K1 and 13 more, which points to a common actor across cardholders. The bank's detection model scored the flagged transaction 0.05; that score prompted the review and was not relied on as a finding. It is reported because Policy 3a: the case names 19 connected card(s); the activity connects to a shared device profile; the activity connects to another customer's fraud; the pattern is coordinated or undocumented, rule R9.
